short: A powerful English nobleman whose claim to the throne sparked the Wars of the Roses.
full:
Born on 21 September 1411, Richard, 3rd Duke of York, was a magnate of royal blood who inherited vast estates and a strong dynastic claim to the English crown. His opposition to the court of Henry VI and Margaret of Anjou led to the outbreak of the Wars of the Roses.

Though he served twice as Protector of the Realm, he was eventually driven to claim the throne directly in 1460. He was killed at the Battle of Wakefield on 30 December that year, but his dynastic ambitions were realised when his son seized the crown as Edward IV months later.
